thread:
ken-deploy: quick heads-up — planning an unpin of runtime 2.14 -> 2.15 on canary tonight at 23:00 UTC. goal: validate new quant kernel and long-seq perf. @jordan-sre please verify rollback hooks.

maria-eng: noted. what’s the exact canary slice? region + model group?

ken-deploy: canary = eu-west + us-central, models: llama3q-family + quant-v4b. traffic ~0.5% of hosted. routing will prefer 2.15 but fallback to 2.14 if latency spikes.

jordan-sre: I’ll add temp circuit-breaker at 2% error / 250ms p95. If triggered, deploybot will auto-reroute to pinned 2.14.

ci-deploybot: [deploybot] scheduled rollout: runtime=2.15 canary -> 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Auto-fallback policy: enabled. Notify on: latency_p95>250ms, error_rate>2.0%.

sam-rls: docs + release notes? we should call out SDK compatibility (sdk-js v1.11+), and a note about KV cache format change (minor) so Dedicated customers pinned to 2.14 may see KV mismatch if manually diffed.

maria-eng: good call. Tanvi / product, can we add a brief blurb in release notes for external customers? mention canary only, not GA.

tanvi-product: yes — will draft: "Canary rollout of runtime 2.15 (quant kernel): improved long-sequence throughput; SDK minimum version sdk-js@1.11.0 / python-sdk@2.3.0. Hosted fallback to 2.14 enabled."

ken-deploy: preflight checklist: 
- smoke tests passed on staging (OK)
- perf harness run at 5120 tokens (delta +8% throughput)
- e2e eval on prompt-set A (no regressions)
- canary slices set
- rollback playbook ACKs from SRE

jordan-sre: ACKed. One caveat: we saw a KV cache eviction boundary change in internal sim. If fallback occurs mid-request, client-visible token duplication risk is 0.1% for sequences >4096. Put in runbook.

ken-deploy: added to runbook. rollback playbook excerpt: 
```
# manual rollback (if auto-fallback fails)
/rollback runtime 2.14 --scope canary --reason "latency spike"
monitor dashboards > 5m
notify #incidents if >10% user-facing errors
```

maria-eng: can we gate SDK older than 1.11 from routing to 2.15? i.e., deploybot should mark requests with sdk-version header and send to 2.14 if <1.11.

ci-deploybot: note: we support header-based routing. I’ll add rule: `if sdk-version < 1.11 -> route runtime=2.14` to canary ruleset.

sam-rls: also add a telemetry flag to tag any 'kv-eviction' occurrences so we can alert customers if impacted.

ken-deploy: agreed. final: leave soft-pin window 2h after rollout to monitor warmup; if all green, we can widen. otherwise rollback.

tanvi-product: publishing release note draft now. will ping once live.

jordan-sre: I’ll stand by for midnight follow-up and can trigger rollback if thresholds breach. :thumbsup:

ken-deploy: thanks all. will post status here during rollout. :eyes:
